name: @moldea.ai/skill-website
description: The private static documentation application for the moldea Agent Skill.

scripts.build: node scripts/generate.ts && astro build && node scripts/verify-build.ts
scripts.build:fixture: node scripts/generate-synthetic.ts && astro build && node scripts/verify-build.ts
scripts.check: npm run docs:check && npm run test:unit && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run build:fixture && npm run test:integration:artifact
scripts.format: prettier --write --config .prettierrc package.json tsconfig.json astro.config.ts eslint.config.ts playwright.config.ts playwright.development.config.ts vitest scripts src
scripts.format:check: prettier --check --config .prettierrc package.json tsconfig.json astro.config.ts eslint.config.ts playwright.config.ts playwright.development.config.ts vitest scripts src
scripts.lint: eslint --flag unstable_native_nodejs_ts_config astro.config.ts eslint.config.ts playwright.config.ts playwright.development.config.ts scripts src vitest
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:recorded && npm run test:e2e:development
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:fixture && npm run test:integration:artifact
